meta.title: Marketing coordinator at a multi-location resort retailer
meta.industry: Resort retail, six shops and an online store
meta.blurb: Runs email campaigns, social posts and in-shop signage.

opportunities.quote: About eight competitor sites and two local news sites, checked by hand
opportunities.why: You check several competitor and news sites by hand to stay current on deals.
opportunities.patternName: Monitoring news and sources as a daily briefing
opportunities.firstStep: List the sources you check and set alerts for the topics, then read one digest a day.
opportunities.failureMode: Too many alerts and the digest becomes another inbox.

rules.name: Task is in the task map
Quoted evidence appears word for word in the visitor's answers
Pattern is in the catalog and every required signal was recorded
Tool is listed on the pattern, with a working link checked within the limit
Hours figures are the ones code computed
A working-habit suggestion carries no hours unless the catalog supplies a share

transcript.question: For "Write social posts", how many posts do you write per week, and where do they go?
options: Posts go to a manager for approval

transcript.question: For "Write social posts", where do the ideas or details for each post come from?
transcript.answer: Customer comments, mostly. Many are the same questions about hours and shipping, so those give me post ideas.

transcript.question: For "Track competitor promotions", how many competitors do you check, and where do you look?
options: A mix of sites, social and emails
transcript.answer: About eight competitor sites and two local news sites, checked by hand a few times a week.

transcript.question: For "Track competitor promotions", where do your findings go afterward?
transcript.answer: Spreadsheet or doc. I note the deals in a doc, and they feed into my own planning.

transcript.question: For "Check social media comments", about how many comments come in per week, and what do you do with them?
For "Triage the inbox", about how many emails do you go through per day?
